records.name: OR-Bench
records.description: Evaluating over-refusal of harmless requests by large language models.
records.descriptionZh: 评估大语言模型对无害请求的过度拒绝。
records.verificationNote: The ICML proceedings abstract identifies OR-Bench as an over-refusal benchmark and links the supplied repository.

records.name: XSTest
records.description: Identifying exaggerated safety behavior using safe prompts and unsafe contrasts.
records.descriptionZh: 通过安全提示及不安全对照提示，识别大语言模型中过度保守的安全行为。
records.verificationNote: The ACL Anthology paper and repository identify XSTest and its NAACL 2024 publication.

records.name: AIR-Bench 2024
records.description: Evaluating language-model safety against risk categories informed by regulations and company policies.
records.descriptionZh: 依据政府法规与企业政策中的风险分类，评估语言模型安全性。
records.verificationNote: The official ICLR 2025 proceedings identify AIR-BENCH 2024. The year denotes the conference publication; 2024 remains part of the benchmark name.

records.name: MSSBench
records.description: Evaluating situational safety in multimodal language models across chat and embodied tasks.
records.descriptionZh: 通过对话与具身任务，评估多模态大语言模型的情境安全性。
records.verificationNote: The official repository identifies the ICLR 2025 Multimodal Situational Safety paper and documents chat and embodied evaluation tasks. The supplied OpenReview link requires browser verification. LLMs reflects the evaluated multimodal language models.

records.name: WMDP
records.description: Proxy evaluation of hazardous knowledge and machine unlearning in language models.
records.descriptionZh: 用于评估语言模型危险知识与机器遗忘的代理基准。
records.verificationNote: The ICML 2024 proceedings and official repository identify WMDP. This catalog records only the project overview and public paper/repository links.

records.name: HallusionBench
records.description: Diagnosing language hallucination and visual illusion in multimodal models.
records.descriptionZh: 诊断多模态模型中的语言幻觉与视觉错觉。
records.verificationNote: The official repository identifies HallusionBench as a CVPR 2024 image-context reasoning benchmark. The supplied CVF page returned HTTP 403 during automated verification. LLMs is the category explicitly requested for the catalog.

records.name: MM-SafetyBench
records.description: Evaluating the safety of multimodal large language models under image-based manipulation.
records.descriptionZh: 评估多模态大语言模型面对图像操纵时的安全性。
records.verificationNote: The arXiv title and official repository identify MM-SafetyBench. The repository records ECCV 2024; the linked preprint first appeared in 2023. The requested publication year is 2024 and category is LLMs.

records.name: SCAM
records.description: Testing AI agents’ security awareness during realistic, multi-turn workplace tasks.
records.descriptionZh: 在真实风格的多轮工作任务中，测试智能体的安全意识。
records.verificationNote: The official project defines SCAM as Security Comprehension Awareness Measure and dates its announcement February 12, 2026.

records.name: SusVibes v1.0
records.description: Evaluating security vulnerabilities in agent-generated code on real-world software-engineering tasks.
records.descriptionZh: 通过真实软件工程任务，评估智能体生成代码中的安全漏洞。
records.verificationNote: The official repository identifies SusVibes and its ICML 2026 publication. The requested display name retains v1.0; the linked repository and leaderboard may evolve beyond that version.

records.name: MASK
records.description: Measuring honesty separately from factual accuracy in language models.
records.descriptionZh: 将诚实性与事实准确性区分开来，评估语言模型的诚实表现。
records.verificationNote: The official project identifies MASK as an honesty benchmark and provides a 2025 citation and the supplied GitHub repository.

records.name: AgentLeak
records.description: Evaluating internal-channel privacy leakage in multi-agent language-model systems.
records.descriptionZh: 评估多智能体语言模型系统内部通道中的隐私泄露。
records.verificationNote: The February 2026 arXiv record and official repository identify AgentLeak and its internal-channel privacy-leakage focus.

records.name: Cybench
records.description: Evaluating cybersecurity capabilities and risks of language-model agents through capture-the-flag tasks.
records.descriptionZh: 通过夺旗任务评估语言模型智能体的网络安全能力与风险。
records.verificationNote: The official Cybench project and repository identify the cybersecurity-agent benchmark. The addition request supplies the 2024 publication year.

records.name: Safety-Gymnasium
records.description: A unified benchmark for safe reinforcement learning in simulated control environments.
records.descriptionZh: 用于在模拟控制环境中评估安全强化学习的统一基准。
records.verificationNote: The arXiv record and official repository identify Safety-Gymnasium and its NeurIPS 2023 publication. Embodied AI is the requested category.

records.name: BBQ
records.description: Evaluating social biases in question answering across ambiguous and disambiguated contexts.
records.descriptionZh: 通过含糊及消歧语境下的问答，评估模型的社会偏见。
records.verificationNote: The ACL Anthology paper and official repository identify the Bias Benchmark for QA and its 2022 publication.

records.name: FigStep
records.description: Typographic visual-prompt jailbreak evaluation for large vision-language models, releasing SafeBench (500 forbidden-topic questions) and reporting attack success rates across open-source LVLMs.
records.descriptionZh: 面向大型视觉语言模型的印刷体视觉提示越狱评测，发布 SafeBench（500 个禁用主题问题），并报告开源 LVLM 上的攻击成功率。
records.verificationNote: arXiv:2311.05608 and AAAI 2025 identify FigStep as a VLM jailbreak evaluation; code and SafeBench are published at ThuCCSLab/FigStep. Added from issue #32.

records.name: ISC-Bench
records.description: Internal Safety Collapse (ISC) evaluation using Task–Validator–Data scenarios across professional disciplines, measuring workflow-triggered harmful generation in frontier LLMs and agentic modes. Highlighted in Awesome-Embodied-AI-Safety news.
records.descriptionZh: 基于任务-校验器-数据场景的内部安全崩溃（ISC）评测，覆盖专业学科，衡量前沿 LLM 与智能体模式下由工作流触发的有害生成。
records.verificationNote: arXiv:2603.23509 and GitHub wuyoscar/ISC-Bench (public, starred) resolve and define ISC-Bench as an evaluation suite. Not in OpenTAI published benchmarks table as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #50.

records.name: EmbodiedBench
records.description: Comprehensive benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs as vision-driven embodied agents across embodied task suites (Awesome-Embodied-AI-Safety).
records.descriptionZh: 评估多模态 LLM 作为视觉驱动具身智能体在具身场景中表现的综合基准。
records.verificationNote: arXiv:2502.09560 and GitHub EmbodiedBench/EmbodiedBench resolve (ICML 2025 Oral). Not in OpenTAI published benchmarks table as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #51.

records.name: IS-Bench
records.description: Interactive Safety benchmark for VLM-driven embodied agents performing daily household tasks (Awesome-Embodied-AI-Safety).
records.descriptionZh: 面向执行日常家务任务的 VLM 驱动具身智能体的交互式安全基准。
records.verificationNote: arXiv:2506.16402 and GitHub AI45Lab/IS-Bench resolve; README marks AAAI 2026. Not in OpenTAI published benchmarks table as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #52.

records.name: AttackVLA
records.description: Benchmark of adversarial and backdoor attacks against Vision-Language-Action models (Awesome-Embodied-AI-Safety).
records.descriptionZh: 针对视觉-语言-动作模型的对抗与后门攻击基准。
records.verificationNote: arXiv:2511.12149 and GitHub lijayuTnT/AttackVLA resolve. Not in OpenTAI published benchmarks table as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #53.

records.name: SkillSafetyBench
records.description: Evaluates agent safety under skill-facing attack surfaces (Awesome-Embodied-AI-Safety / agent safety).
records.descriptionZh: 评估智能体在面向技能的攻击面上的安全性。
records.verificationNote: arXiv:2605.12015 and GitHub AI45Lab/skill-safety-bench resolve. Not in OpenTAI published benchmarks table as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #54.

records.name: EmbodiedGovBench
records.description: Benchmark for governance, recovery, and upgrade safety in embodied agent systems (Awesome-Embodied-AI-Safety).
records.descriptionZh: 面向具身智能体系统中治理、恢复与升级安全的基准。
records.verificationNote: arXiv:2604.11174 and GitHub s20sc/embodied-gov-bench resolve. Not in OpenTAI published benchmarks table as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #55.

records.name: ALERT
records.description: Large-scale red-teaming safety benchmark with red-team prompts for assessing LLM guardrails (HF configs expose test splits only).
records.descriptionZh: 大规模红队安全基准，提供红队提示以评估 LLM 护栏。
records.verificationNote: arXiv:2404.08676, GitHub Babelscape/ALERT, and HF Babelscape/ALERT resolve; card titles it a Benchmark with test-only splits → Benchmark (not Dataset). Not in OpenTAI published benchmarks table as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #56.

records.name: Aya Red-teaming
records.description: Human-annotated multilingual red-teaming prompts across 8 languages and 9 harm categories for evaluating LLM safety (eval/red-team resource).
records.descriptionZh: 跨 8 种语言、9 类危害的人工标注多语种红队提示，用于评估多语种 LLM 安全。
records.verificationNote: HF CohereLabs/aya_redteaming and arXiv:2406.18682 resolve; presented as red-teaming evaluation prompts (Benchmark). Not in OpenTAI published benchmarks table as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #57.

records.name: PolygloToxicityPrompts
records.description: Multilingual toxicity evaluation prompt benchmark curated from web text (ptp-full / ptp-small splits).
records.descriptionZh: 从网络文本整理的多语种毒性评测提示基准（ptp-full / ptp-small 划分）。
records.verificationNote: HF ToxicityPrompts/PolygloToxicityPrompts resolves and describes a multilingual toxicity evaluation benchmark. Not in OpenTAI published benchmarks table as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #58.

records.name: In-The-Wild Jailbreak Prompts
records.description: JailbreakHub measurement resource of in-the-wild jailbreak prompts for characterizing and evaluating jailbreaks on LLMs.
records.descriptionZh: JailbreakHub 对野外越狱提示的测量资源，用于刻画并评估越狱攻击。
records.verificationNote: arXiv:2308.03825 (CCS 2024), GitHub TrustAIRLab/JailbreakHub, and HF TrustAIRLab/in-the-wild-jailbreak-prompts resolve as an evaluation/measurement benchmark. Not in OpenTAI published benchmarks table as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #59.

records.name: Nemotron-AIQ Agentic Safety
records.description: Agentic safety/security contextual-risk evaluation set for research assistants in agentic systems (NVIDIA evaluation-dataset license).
records.descriptionZh: 面向智能体系统中研究助手的情境风险评测集（智能体安全/安保）。
records.verificationNote: HF nvidia/Nemotron-AIQ-Agentic-Safety-Dataset-1.0 resolves; license_name nvidia-evaluation-dataset-license and card framing indicate evaluation → Benchmark (not training Dataset). Not in OpenTAI published benchmarks table as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #60.

records.name: OpenART
records.description: Docker-native agent red-teaming arena for long-horizon, stateful tool-using code agents. Evaluates multi-step state poisoning, privilege escalation, and tool-use vulnerabilities via evolving environments (paper reports 10K+ validated scenarios across 50 domains; public HF releases include planner tasks and tool corpora). Reference attacker: EMHA.
records.descriptionZh: 面向长程、有状态、使用工具的代码智能体的 Docker 原生红队竞技场，评估多步状态投毒、权限提升与工具使用漏洞。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-20: GitHub AI45Lab/OpenART (public AGPL-3.0 runtime + example tasks), arXiv:2608.00677, and HF planner-tasks/tools datasets. Classified as **Benchmark only** under OpenTAI BM/DS boundary (eval arena; HF artifacts support evaluation/reproducibility, no first-hand training-split evidence for Dataset dual-listing). Not previously on-site or filed as a submission Issue. Added from issue #61.

records.name: DTap
records.description: Controllable interactive red-teaming platform for AI agents spanning 14 real-world domains and 50+ simulation environments, with autonomous DTAP-RED attacker and public trajectory benchmark releases.
records.descriptionZh: 面向 AI 智能体的可控交互式红队平台，覆盖 14 个现实领域与 50+ 场景。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-20: GitHub AI-secure/DecodingTrust-Agent, arXiv:2605.04808, HF AI-Secure/DTap-Bench-Agent-Trajectories. Listed in OpenTAI ecosystem-catalog arenas but missing from Resources Benchmarks. Classified Benchmark (eval arena/platform). OpenART (#61) not duplicated. Added from issue #62.

records.name: VLSBench
records.description: Multimodal visual leakless safety benchmark (2.4k image-text pairs) that removes visual safety information leakage from text queries to stress-test MLLM safety alignment.
records.descriptionZh: 多模态无视觉泄漏安全基准（2.4k 图文对），去除视觉安全线索以评估 MLLM 安全性。
records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/VLSBench, arXiv:2411.19939 (ACL 2025), HF Foreshhh/vlsbench resolve. Eval-focused multimodal safety benchmark; not on Resources Benchmarks or prior Issues. Added from issue #63.

records.name: MLLMGuard
records.description: Multi-dimensional bilingual image-text safety evaluation suite for MLLMs with privacy, bias, toxicity, hallucination and related axes plus lightweight evaluators.
records.descriptionZh: 面向 MLLM 的多维度双语图文安全评测套件，覆盖隐私、偏见、毒性等。
records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/MLLMGuard, arXiv:2406.07594, HF Carol0110/MLLMGuard resolve as an evaluation suite. Not on Resources Benchmarks or prior Issues. Added from issue #64.

records.name: RiOSWorld
records.description: Benchmark for risk evaluation of multimodal computer-use agents in OS-world style environments, with released evaluation trajectory data.
records.descriptionZh: 在类 OS-World 环境中评估多模态计算机使用智能体风险的基准。
records.verificationNote: Canonical GitHub yjyddq/RiOSWorld (AI45Lab mirror exists), arXiv:2506.00618 (NeurIPS 2025), HF JY-Young/RiOSWorld resolve. Eval trajectories; Benchmark only. Not on Resources or Issues. Added from issue #65.

records.name: ReflectionBench
records.description: Cognitive-psychology-inspired benchmark evaluating epistemic agency of LLMs across prediction, decision-making, perception, memory, counterfactuals, belief updating, and meta-reflection.
records.descriptionZh: 受认知心理学启发的基准，评估 LLM 在预测、决策等环节的认知能动性。
records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/ReflectionBench, arXiv:2410.16270 (ICML 2025), project ReflectionBench.github.io resolve. Agent/LLM epistemic evaluation suite. Not on Resources or Issues. Added from issue #66.

records.name: SafeVerse
records.description: Open generative evolution arena for trustworthy embodied AI: video-to-interactive 3D scenes with automated attack-defense exercises and closed-loop adversarial evolution.
records.descriptionZh: 面向可信具身 AI 的开放生成式演化竞技场：视频到交互式 3D 场景并自动演化。
records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/SafeVerse resolves (public arena/runtime). OpenART-like embodied eval arena → Benchmark. No separate arXiv ID found at filing time; GitHub primary. Not on Resources Benchmarks or Issues (OpenART #61 not duplicated). Added from issue #67.

records.name: PseudoBench
records.description: Adversarial benchmark measuring whether agentic auto-research systems can identify and resist pseudoscientific narratives across curated claim-evidence items and domains.
records.descriptionZh: 对抗基准，衡量智能体自动研究系统能否识别并抵制伪科学/错误研究轨迹。
records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/PseudoBench and arXiv:2606.18060 resolve. Agent trustworthy-research evaluation. Not on Resources or Issues. Added from issue #68.

records.name: T2ISafety
records.description: Safety benchmark for text-to-image models covering toxicity, fairness, and privacy with a hierarchical taxonomy (12 tasks / 44 categories) and large annotated prompt-image evaluation set.
records.descriptionZh: 面向文生图模型的安全基准，覆盖毒性、公平与隐私，并采用分层分类。
records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/T2ISafety, arXiv:2501.12612 (ICLR 2025 OpenReview), resolves. Eval benchmark for generative image safety. Not on Resources or Issues. Added from issue #69.

records.name: ActorAttack
records.description: Multi-turn jailbreak attack/evaluation method that discovers semantic actor clues to derail LLMs, releasing Attack_600 multi-turn harmful query paths for evaluation.
records.descriptionZh: 多轮越狱攻击/评测方法，通过发现语义角色线索诱导 LLM 偏离，并发布评测资源。
records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/ActorAttack, arXiv:2410.10700, HF SafeMTData/SafeMTData (Attack_600 eval + SafeMTData_1K alignment) resolve. Filed as Benchmark for the attack evaluation protocol; SafeMTData already on-site as Dataset keep — not re-filed. Added from issue #70.

records.name: ATBench
records.description: Diverse realistic agent-trajectory safety benchmark family (ATBench / ATBench500 / Claw / Codex) for evaluating and diagnosing agent safety failures.
records.descriptionZh: 多样化现实智能体轨迹安全基准系列（ATBench / ATBench500 / Claw / Codex）。
records.verificationNote: arXiv:2604.02022, HF AI45Research/ATBench (test splits), GitHub AI45Lab/AgentDoG resolve. Explicit benchmark tags and test-only configs → Benchmark. Distinct from AgentDoG Model submission. Added from issue #71.

records.name: CodeAttack
records.description: Code-completion jailbreak / safety-generalization evaluation that reformulates harmful intents as code to probe LLM safety gaps.
records.descriptionZh: 将有害意图改写为代码补全的越狱/安全泛化评测。
records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/CodeAttack and arXiv:2403.07865 (ACL 2024) resolve. Safety evaluation via code-domain attacks. Not on Resources or Issues. Added from issue #72.
